exposure: single strain probiotic (Bifidobacterium breve M-16 V,)
two-strain probiotic (Lactobacillus acidophilus and Bifidobacterium bifidum)
outcome: time to reach full enteral feeds
cohort: Preterm infants (<32 weeks and/or birth weight <1,500 g) receiving probiotic prophylaxis for prevention of NEC.
finding: In this study of preterm infants, clinical outcomes of single vs. two-strain probiotic prophylaxis for prevention of NEC were similar.
